title: The Lost Expedition
description: After discovering Alethius's note in Nchuand-Zel, search for his missing expedition members by recovering their journals, reactivate the city's automated defenses, and report the findings to Calcelmo in Understone Keep.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Markarth and the foremost scholar of the Dwemer in all of Tamriel.
I work in my laboratory in Understone Keep.
I would be very interested in any news of expeditions into Dwemer ruins, especially Nchuand-Zel beneath Markarth.

CALCELMO_INFORMED: The entire expedition into Nchuand-Zel was wiped out by Falmer and traps.
I have rewarded the adventurer for recovering the expedition's journals and reactivating the city's defenses.

base_facts: I was part of an expedition into Nchuand-Zel to study the Dwemer ruins.
I left a note asking that someone find the other researchers in my group.

beats.comment: Player finds Alethius's note and begins searching for the missing researchers.
Player discovers Stromm's corpse and diary, now must find the other three expedition members.
All four journals recovered. Player learns the expedition was wiped out trying to reactivate the city defenses and must find the lever Staubin mentioned.
Player pulls the lever and activates Nchuand-Zel's automatons to drive out the Falmer. Must now find someone who knows about the expedition.
Player reports to Calcelmo in Understone Keep and receives a leveled gold reward. Quest complete.
